name: Uki Uki Island
source:
A group of high school students (3 boys and 3 girls) decide to go on a lost island, called Daikokujima ("big black island") as a club event of the "Exploration Club". One of the islanders disappears and the new goal of the club is to get her whereabouts.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-april-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
